---
description: Auditable processing and consent signals in privacy plans and reviews
applyTo: '**/.copilot-tracking/privacy-plans/**, **/.copilot-tracking/privacy-reviews/**'
---

# Privacy Telemetry

In privacy plans, record observable data-processing decisions, consent-state transitions, and retention or erasure events as auditable log or metric signals. In reviews, flag findings about processing or consent signals that lack corresponding log or metric evidence. Record the event and outcome, not the personal data, identifiers, consent text, credentials, or payload. Use documented semantic conventions and bounded metric attributes; flag missing evidence instead of inventing a signal.
